reports.title: Alamar Biosciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises 2026 Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Alamar Biosciences now expects full year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $121 to $123 million, representing growth of 64% at the midpoint of the range compared to full year 2025. This compares to its previous expectations of $116 to $120 million for full year 2026.
